anatomy.authority: ANAT1 MediaPipe 468-point face mask supplies the lower jaw / cheek / temple chain from its 36-index reference ring. The skull vault is NOT in that mask: it is separately authored from observed cranial proportions using 8 new parietal/frontal arch anchors.
anatomy.caveat: Sex parameter is a mesh morph parameter, not an individual's inferred sex or identity. No reference-aligned anatomy fidelity claim; the model face mask excludes skull back/ears/hairline.

character_spec.geometry: New 36-index 3D face ring used for source-informed temple/lower face. Exactly one independent head silhouette joins mesh lower outline to 8 newly drafted cranial vault arcs; 342 bounded short colored pencil contacts in 3 optical value passes plus 5 named light construction guides. No old character paths or features.
character_spec.one_at_a_time_gate: No second character or facial feature before stage-1 silhouette is rendered at 1x/2.15x, proportion/plane masks reviewed, and any topology defect corrected.

five_axes.topology: one editable standalone head, no old portrait parts and no face stickers. Mark visible missing cranium behind the mask as blocker, not as finished skull.
five_axes.vector_flow: 3 curved local pressure fans run from forehead through zygomatic bones to jaw; no global diagonal identical strokes
five_axes.weight: low pressure ochre/rose/sepia head plane values; subtle mandibular and zygomatic turn, not solid gradient contour
five_axes.rhythm: 3 × 114 short strokes follow three bony guides with deterministic irregular offsets, not wallpaper
five_axes.texture: 3 independent CP-F1 skin-material pigment passes over paper tooth with no bitmap, image filters or external media
